issue_context.title: LaCrosse View Unsupported sensor field: Flex
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The Flex field is exposed from the [pool sensor](https://www.lacrossetechnology.com/products/ltv-pool). It's probably not useful at all - the value is always 0.0 and is in `no_units` and it is not shown in the official app.

The server response for the device looks like this:

```python
{
    'Temperature': {'values': [{'u': 1650900346, 's': 14.4}, {'u': 1662901751, 's': 26.4}], 'unit_enum': 4225, 'unit': 'degrees_celsius'}, 
    'Flex': {'values': [{'u': 1650900346, 's': 0.0}, {'u': 1662901751, 's': 0.0}], 'unit_enum': 256, 'unit': 'no_units'}
}
```


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.9.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

LaCrosse View

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/lacrosse_view/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

_No response_
